blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 十三人の少年少女が機兵と呼ばれるメカに乗って怪獣と戦う。２Ｄグラフィックで有名な開発元のヴァニラウェア渾身の一作。
blocks.translation: Thirteen boys and girls ride mechs called Sentinels to battle kaiju. This is Vanillaware's passion project, from the developer famous for its 2D graphics.

blocks.source: 正確なジャンルは『ドラマチックアドベンチャーゲーム』だとか。ＳＲＰＧ的なモノとも分類できるので、せっかくなのでレビュー。
blocks.translation: Apparently, its exact genre is a “dramatic adventure game.” Since it can also be classified as something resembling an SRPG, I decided to review it.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Mass / Story

blocks.source: クリア（トロフィーもコンプリート）までは３０時間強。
blocks.translation: It took just over 30 hours to clear the game (including completing all the trophies).

blocks.source: ゲームはＳＲＰＧ的な戦闘を行う『崩壊編』、ストーリーを進める『追想編』の二つに分かれる。
blocks.translation: The game is divided into two parts: “The Destruction,” which features SRPG-style battles, and “The Remembrance,” which advances the story.

blocks.source: この二つを任意に切り替えながら、進行していくことになる。
blocks.translation: You progress by switching between these two parts as you wish.

blocks.source: もう一つ『究明編』もあるが、これは資料集＆回想的なもの
blocks.translation: There is also “The Conspiracy,” but this is essentially a collection of reference materials and reminiscences.

blocks.source: プレイ時間の多くを占める追想編では、十三人の物語を切り替えながら崩壊編に至るまでの経緯を追っていく。
blocks.translation: In The Remembrance, which accounts for most of the playtime, you follow the events leading up to The Destruction while switching between the stories of the thirteen characters.

blocks.source: タダでさえ十三も主人公がいるのに、難解なＳＦ物語になっているので、非常にややこしい。
blocks.translation: Even with thirteen protagonists to begin with, it is an extremely complicated science-fiction story, making it very confusing.

blocks.source: ＳＦの定番、タイムトラベル要素はもちろんある。
blocks.translation: Of course, it includes the classic science-fiction element of time travel.

blocks.source: 一人の主人公を中心に進めていても突然話が飛ぶ。
blocks.translation: Even when following one protagonist, the story suddenly jumps elsewhere.

blocks.source: 他の主人公の物語で補間しないと理解できない。
blocks.translation: You cannot understand it without filling in the gaps with the other protagonists' stories.

blocks.source: 過去へと戻る回想が多用される。
blocks.translation: Flashbacks returning to the past are used extensively.

blocks.source: 主人公毎の時系列もバラバラ。
blocks.translation: The timelines for each protagonist are also all mixed up.

blocks.source: とある主人公の冒頭が、他の主人公の後半からつながっていたり。
blocks.translation: The beginning of one protagonist's story may connect to the latter half of another protagonist's story.

blocks.source: 意図的にミスリードを連発している。
blocks.translation: It deliberately uses one misleading twist after another.

blocks.source: などなど……。
blocks.translation: And so on…

blocks.source: 特に序盤は訳が分からない。というか、クリアしただけでは全体を把握するのは難しい。
blocks.translation: It is especially incomprehensible in the early stages. In fact, it is difficult to grasp the whole picture simply by clearing the game.

blocks.source: この辺は必要以上に話を複雑にしている印象を受けた。
blocks.translation: I felt that the story was made more complicated than necessary in this respect.

blocks.source: 究明編ではキャラクター別に時系列で回想を閲覧できるので、把握の役に立つと思う。
blocks.translation: In The Conspiracy, you can view flashbacks in chronological order for each character, which I think helps you understand the story.

blocks.source: ともあれ、十三人（＋α）はそれぞれ個性豊かで魅力的。
blocks.translation: In any case, the thirteen characters (plus α) are all distinctive and appealing.

blocks.source: ＳＦ的な要素をこれでもかというほど詰め込んだ先の気になるストーリー。好きな人にはたまらないはず。
blocks.translation: It is an intriguing story packed to the brim with science-fiction elements. Fans of the genre should love it.

blocks.source: 基本的にはネタバレ厳禁なゲームなので余り語ることはありません。
blocks.translation: Since this is fundamentally a game where spoilers are strictly forbidden, I will not say much more.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 崩壊編、追想編を任意に切り替えながら進めることになるのだが、これがなかなかの悩みどころ。
blocks.translation: You progress while switching between The Destruction and The Remembrance as you wish, but this can be quite a dilemma.

blocks.source: 追想編は尋常ではなく話が複雑なので、できれば連続して進めたい。
blocks.translation: The Remembrance has an exceptionally complex story, so ideally you would play through it continuously.

blocks.source: かといって、崩壊編もある程度は進めないとロックがかかって進めなくなる。そもそも、後回しにしていると、後でひたすらＳＲＰＧ戦闘を繰り返すハメになる。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, if you do not make some progress in The Destruction, it becomes locked and you cannot proceed. Besides, if you put it off, you will eventually be forced to repeat SRPG battles over and over.

blocks.source: ……というように、頭の切替が必要となるのはなかなか厄介だと感じた。
blocks.translation: As you can imagine, having to switch gears mentally like this was rather troublesome.

blocks.source: 追想編
blocks.translation: The Remembrance

blocks.source: 十三人の主人公を切り替えながら進む２Ｄ製ＡＤＶ。
blocks.translation: A 2D adventure game in which you progress by switching between thirteen protagonists.

blocks.source: キーワードを駆使するなどの多少のゲーム性はあるが、あくまでストーリーを追うことが中心となる。
blocks.translation: There is some gameplay, such as making use of keywords, but the main focus is firmly on following the story.

blocks.source: 一度聞いた会話や演出はＲ１ボタンで早送りできるなど、快適性にも配慮がされている。
blocks.translation: It also takes convenience into consideration, allowing previously heard dialogue and seen scenes to be fast-forwarded with the R1 button.

blocks.source: ほぼ一本道のイベント中でも、頻繁にプレイヤーへ操作を戻すのだけがちょっと気になった。
blocks.translation: Even during events that are almost entirely linear, I found it slightly distracting that control was so frequently returned to the player.

blocks.source: 崩壊編（戦闘）
blocks.translation: The Destruction (Battles)

blocks.source: ＳＲＰＧ戦闘の難易度は低め。
blocks.translation: The SRPG battles are on the easy side.

blocks.source: 十三人とその搭乗する機兵を操って怪獣と戦うことになる。
blocks.translation: You control the thirteen characters and the Sentinels they pilot as they battle kaiju.

blocks.source: ノーマル（難易度変更可能）ならば、普通にやっていて負けることはほとんどないと思う。ステージ毎にクリア成績がつくのだけれど、２つを除いて初回で最高のＳランクを獲得できた。
blocks.translation: On Normal (the difficulty can be changed), I doubt you will lose very often playing normally. Each stage receives a clear rating, and I earned the highest S rank on my first attempt for all but two stages.

blocks.source: 基本的には遠距離攻撃だけで敵を圧倒できる。兵装には防御・回復系のものも存在するが、まず世話になることはなかった。
blocks.translation: You can generally overwhelm enemies with ranged attacks alone. There are also defensive and healing armaments, but I hardly ever needed them.

blocks.source: ただし、第３エリアのラストだけは桁違いに難しい。
blocks.translation: However, only the final battle of Area 3 is incomparably difficult.

blocks.source: もし、難しいようでも以前のステージに戻って稼ぐこともできる。
blocks.translation: Even if things seem difficult, you can return to earlier stages to grind.

blocks.source: 試行錯誤する楽しさは薄いけれど、大量の敵を倒すのは爽快感があって気持ち良い。
blocks.translation: Although it offers little of the fun of trial and error, defeating large numbers of enemies is exhilarating and satisfying.

blocks.source: プレイ時間的にも、追想編のほうが作品の中核だという印象は受けた。
blocks.translation: In terms of playtime as well, I got the impression that the Reminiscence Arc is the core of the game.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 追想編の物語は、ヴァニラウェア製の美麗な２Ｄグラフィックで描かれる。２Ｄとしては一種の究極系に近いんじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: The story of the Reminiscence Arc is depicted with beautiful 2D graphics created by Vanillaware. As 2D goes, I’d say they approach a kind of ultimate form.

blocks.source: 対する崩壊編では、記号的な３Ｄグラフィックに留まっている。
blocks.translation: By contrast, the Destruction Arc is limited to symbolic 3D graphics.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲は崎元仁氏らのチーム。
blocks.translation: The music was composed by a team including Hitoshi Sakimoto.

blocks.source: 追想編ではどちらかというと背景的で目立たない。
blocks.translation: In the Reminiscence Arc, it tends to be more atmospheric and unobtrusive.

blocks.source: 崩壊編のバトルパートでは燃える曲なども。印象に残るのは、歌付きの曲が流れるとあるシーンだろう。
blocks.translation: The battle segments in the Destruction Arc include some fiery tracks. The most memorable part is probably a certain scene where a song with vocals plays.

blocks.source: このレビューでは相対的に低めの点数になっているけど、クオリティ自体は高い。プレイ時間の大半を占める追想編で、曲が目立たないので余り評価のしようがないというだけです。
blocks.translation: Although it receives a relatively low score in this review, its quality is high in itself. The only reason is that the music is unobtrusive in the Reminiscence Arc, which accounts for most of the playtime, so there is not much to evaluate.
